My role: Social Media Strategy

Created a five-pillar tone-of-voice framework, translating dense tech-policy research into clear brand voice guidelines that now guide RIL's social content across every audience. Adopted team-wide, the framework cut content review cycles by roughly a third and became the reference standard for onboarding new writers.

ActionableShare tools and steps stakeholders can actually use.
RigorousFact-check everything; reason from first principles.
AuthenticStay true to the mission; credit other voices in the space.
ConversationalRespond like a person, within business hours, no jargon.
TransparentShow differing views and the full picture, plainly.

Guidance I built into the framework: research posts read as authoritative and evidence-led; replies to followers get more room to be playful and personable. Since rollout, the framework has anchored a noticeably more consistent brand voice across RIL's channels.
